title: Security-minded engineer
summary: Networks, cryptography, certificates and authentication understood from the inside, then attacked and defended on live machines and in the pipeline.
outcome: Ready to review a design or pull request for security: spot the weak crypto, the broken trust chain, the leaky token and the open port, and fix them.

stages.title: How traffic really flows
stages.why: You cannot defend what you cannot see. Addressing, TCP, DNS, HTTP and TLS, and the basic attacks on each layer.
stages.milestone: Explains what an attacker on the same network can see and change, layer by layer

stages.title: Cryptography you can use correctly
stages.why: Most crypto bugs are misuse, not broken maths: the wrong mode, a reused nonce, a fast hash for passwords. Learn the primitives and the mistakes, then build a vault.
stages.milestone: Encrypts data at rest with authenticated encryption and stores passwords the right way

stages.title: Certificates and trust
stages.why: TLS is only as good as the chain behind it. Roots, intermediates, revocation and the commands that diagnose an expired or mis-chained certificate.
stages.milestone: Runs a small CA and fixes a broken chain from the error message alone

stages.title: Identity and access
stages.why: Broken access control tops the OWASP list. Sessions, JWTs, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and securing a real API against the common attacks.
stages.milestone: Reviews an auth flow and finds the token, cookie or redirect flaw

stages.title: Attack and defend, for real
stages.why: Theory sticks once you have captured the packets and closed the port yourself. Live labs on containers: capture, scan, firewall, TLS, logs and SSH hardening.
stages.milestone: Scans a host, closes what should not be open and proves it from the logs

stages.title: Secure delivery
stages.why: Attackers go for the build: dependencies, secrets in pipelines, fat images and regexes that hang. Security that lives in CI scales to every team.
stages.milestone: Adds secret scanning, dependency checks and a hardened image to a pipeline
